blocks.text: Virginia Food, Inc. is bringing Sanrio character designs to its Christmas Bag of Treats this holiday season through its “A Smile in Each Hello” campaign, combining a familiar Filipino Christmas offering with characters loved by children, longtime fans, and adults who grew up with Hello Kitty. For many Filipinos, Christmas is a time for sharing gifts that reflect the recipient’s interests and memories. Sanrio characters such as Hello Kitty, My Melody, Kuromi, and Cinnamoroll offer that familiar connection, while their continued presence in contemporary kawaii culture introduces them to younger fans.
